original.statement: OperatorHub packages for cert-manager are no longer published; v1.16.5 is the last release available on OperatorHub, and v1.17.0+ cannot be installed via that distribution channel.

decision.reason: [ev-a89ac42d3167] says cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages and that v1.16.5 is the last release on OperatorHub. This covers both the RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io, and the cert-manager-olm repository is archived. That ends cert-manager's distribution relationship with another product (OperatorHub). So product-relationship with name "operatorhub" and change type "removed" match what the evidence states.
